configs/RGBNT201/Signal.yml.text:
MODEL:
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: 'ViT-B-16'
  STRIDE_SIZE: [ 16, 16 ]
  SIE_CAMERA: True
  DIRECT: 1
  SIE_COE: 1.0
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.25
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
  Gram_Loss_weight: 0.2
  PAT_Loss_weight: 0.2
  USE_A: True
  TOPK: 80
  USE_B: True
  stageName: 'together_CLS_Patch'     # [CLS,  together_CLS_Patch]
  
  

INPUT:
  SIZE_TRAIN: [ 256, 128 ]
  SIZE_TEST: [ 256, 128 ]
  PROB: 0.5 # random horizontal flip
  RE_PROB: 0.5 # random erasing
  PADDING: 10

DATALOADER:
  SAMPLER: 'softmax_triplet'
  NUM_INSTANCE: 8
  NUM_WORKERS: 12

DATASETS:
  NAMES: ('RGBNT201')
  ROOT_DIR: '..'

SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 0.00035
  WARMUP_ITERS: 10
  MAX_EPOCHS: 50
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: 'Adam'
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  EVAL_PERIOD: 1

TEST:
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 128
  RE_RANKING: 'no'
  WEIGHT: ''
  NECK_FEAT: 'before'
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  MISS: "nothing"

OUTPUT_DIR: '.'
ckpt_save_path: 'RGBNT201_all'
ckpt_test_path:  'test_RNT201'

configs/MSVR310/Signal.yml.text:
MODEL:
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: 'ViT-B-16'
  STRIDE_SIZE: [ 16, 16 ]
  SIE_CAMERA: True
  SIE_COE: 1.0
  DIRECT: 0
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.25
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
  Gram_Loss_weight: 0.2
  PAT_Loss_weight: 0.01
  USE_A: True
  TOPK: 64
  USE_B: True
  stageName: 'together_CLS_Patch'     # [CLS,  together_CLS_Patch]

INPUT:
  SIZE_TRAIN: [ 128, 256 ]
  SIZE_TEST: [ 128, 256 ]
  PROB: 0.5 # random horizontal flip
  RE_PROB: 0.5 # random erasing
  PADDING: 10

DATALOADER:
  SAMPLER: 'softmax_triplet'
  NUM_INSTANCE: 4
  NUM_WORKERS: 8

DATASETS:
  NAMES: ('MSVR310')
  ROOT_DIR: '..'

SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 5e-6
  WARMUP_ITERS: 0
  MAX_EPOCHS: 50
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: 'Adam'
  GAMMA: 0.1
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  EVAL_PERIOD: 1
  STEPS: [20, 40]


TEST:
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  RE_RANKING: 'no'
  WEIGHT: ''
  NECK_FEAT: 'before'
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  MISS: "nothing"

OUTPUT_DIR: '.'
ckpt_save_path: 'MSVR310_all'
ckpt_test_path: 'test_MSVR310'
